verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks joined by a blank line, in page order: each paragraph and each ordered-list item of the defined term's definition body. Defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures are omitted; no word was changed. Ordered-list items carry a parenthesized label that is the item's ORDINAL POSITION within its HTML ordered-list, one distinct family per nesting depth so nesting is never ambiguous (depth 1 arabic (1); depth 2 lowercase roman (i); depth 3 lowercase letter (a); depth 4 uppercase letter (A)). Because the §12-10 print/PDF channel is unavailable (504), these labels are a markup-position representation, NOT a transcription of a confirmed label glyph; the item TEXT is verbatim from the sha256-pinned canonical HTML.
